Multi-Entity IT Systems — Innovis Telecom

MIS Lead, IT Systems & Infrastructure Innovis Telecom Services Feb 2026 – Apr 2026

Overview

IT systems and infrastructure lead across 5 group entities: Microsoft 365 administration, VoIP (3CX, Teams Calling, Zoom Phone), LAN/WLAN and RDP operations, Odoo ERP support and IT security compliance.

Skills Used

Microsoft 365 VoIP Administration Network Operations Odoo Support IT Security

The Challenge

Five group entities, each with its own users, vendors and habits — but one IT team. Accounts drifted out of alignment, telephony was a mix of platforms, and support requests arrived through every channel except the right one.

What I Did

Unified identity & Microsoft 365

Administered Microsoft 365 across all entities: licence hygiene, shared mailbox structure, and access policies aligned with IT security compliance requirements.

VoIP consolidation

Managed 3CX, Teams Calling and Zoom Phone: call flows, DID assignment, user provisioning and vendor escalation — so telephony stopped being a per-office mystery.

Infrastructure & support

Ran L1/L2 support, LAN/WLAN and RDP operations, and supported the Odoo ERP instance — logging incidents properly and feeding recurring issues back into training and process fixes.

Outcome

  • Consistent IT operations across 5 entities
  • Predictable VoIP experience with clear ownership per platform
  • Recurring issues reduced through incident analysis and user training
  • Security compliance maintained across the group
